music_brief: warm, feel-good acoustic indie-pop instrumental (90–110 BPM) with a plucky motif, claps and light drums: curious playful start, a near-silent break for the twist, a bright lift on the reveal and a warm resolve for the WebDrip logo — sunny and kid-friendly, never club

music_track.title: Summer City (Instrumental Version)
music_track.why: quirky, playful instrumental indie pop at 95.7 BPM; from a 9-track instrumental acoustic/indie-pop shortlist it had the strongest punch (highest onset strength) with low 1–4 kHz density and a built-in near-silent break before a full-band re-entry; fitted with Epidemic Sound EditRecording (natural-tempo 63 s edit with the 29.5–48 s lift at 0 s and the 56.5–63 s re-entry at 36.5 s, trimmed to 45 s with a 2 s fade) so the break sits under 'Nobody will ever know' (9.5–10.2 s), the band re-enters on 'Now, this one' and the strongest late hit at 39.01 s lands the WebDrip logo

vo_hook: Two swim schools. Ten seconds. One thumb.
caption_hook: Bet you'd book this swim school in ten seconds flat 👀

design_style: TypeUI 'riso' — two-colour risograph print look on warm paper (Space Grotesk 700 display with a pink misregistration offset + Overpass Mono labels, 8–10px radii, 2px federal-blue borders and solid offset print shadows, halftone dots and paper grain); hero = full-bleed 3D camera photo with bottom-left headline and a 'repair ticket' card on the right, then a price-card grid, a numbered 2×2 how-it-works grid with count-ups, a split spotlight, three care-plan cards and a split booking form — chosen because a print-shop zine feel suits a hands-on neighbourhood workshop and riso hasn't been used in the last 10 runs
story_angle: The 9pm snapped chain: a rider's chain snaps after closing time; the owner's old one-page site has no prices and no booking, so they book across town — picture a site that takes the booking at 9pm instead, and the owner wakes up to it
edit_style: Clock-driven night-to-morning timeline with real 3D camera moves (crane rise, orbit + dolly, card lift-out); iris wipe and shared-element handoff transitions; type-led with riso misregistration
music_brief: warm, hopeful soul with a male lead vocal (~95 BPM): soft intro and verse under the after-hours problem, the pre-chorus line 'turn things around' on the story's turn, and the chorus under the booking payoff and the WebDrip logo

music_track.title: Links in a Chain
music_track.why: clean, hopeful male soul vocal whose own lyric ('we can make it happen, turn things around') lands on the story's turn and whose chorus carries the booking; first vocal song in the log; fitted with EditRecording (one required region, natural tempo) — DownloadRecording returned FORBIDDEN on this plan
